event.location_text: 马六甲海峡，Phillip Channel，分道通航制（TSS）东行航道
event.injury: two crew tied up and locked in

sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: While underway, four perpetrators armed with guns and knives boarded the ship and entered the engine room. They tied two duty oilers and locked them in the CO2 room before they escaped with stolen engine spares. The second Engineer later discovered the duty oilers and freed them. The alarm was raised, crew mustered and a search onboard was conducted.
